# Math the golden corpus renders besides the demo vault's (#1559).
# One LaTeX expression per line, as written between dollar signs.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.

# Matrices and arrays.
\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}
\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \end{bmatrix}
\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}
\begin{Vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{Vmatrix}
\begin{array}{cc} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{array}

# Cases, with a comparison in a condition.
f(x) = \begin{cases} x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}
\begin{cases} 1 & n = 0 \\ n \cdot f(n - 1) & n > 0 \end{cases}

# Double-struck and bold letters.
\mathbb{R}^n
\mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R}
\mathbb{N}
\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{w}
\boldsymbol{\alpha} + \boldsymbol{\beta}

# Named functions.
\operatorname{Log} z
\operatorname{arccotan} x
\arctan x
\sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta = 1
\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x}

# Vector calculus.
\nabla f
\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F}
\nabla \times \mathbf{F}
\nabla^2 \phi

# Comparisons and the ampersand.
x < y
a \le b \le c
x > 0
a \& b
\alpha \ne \beta
\nless x

# Ellipses.
1, 2, \ldots, n
a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n
\vdots

# Calculus and roots.
\int_0^1 x^2 \, dx
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i^2
\prod_{k=1}^{n} k
\sqrt[3]{x}
\frac{d}{dx} e^{x}
\binom{n}{k}

# Sources pulldown-latex cannot render faithfully: spoken as their source.
{n \choose k}
\mathscr{L}
\sideset{_a^b}{_c^d}\sum
\frac{<}{
\operatorname{<mi>x</mi>}

# Primes (#1585): a prime after an element is its superscript; two fold into
# one double prime; three keep their MathML and braille as parsed and are spoken
# folded (#1628); a primed function or script is grouped first; the last five pin the edge carriers.
f''(x)
f'''(x)
x_1'
\sin'(x)
\sin^2'(x)
2\sin'(x)
|x|'
\left(fg\right)'(x)
\sum_{n}' a_n
y''^2

# Scripted functions after an atom (#1629): the writer's thin space before
# the function leaves the script element, and a function as an ungrouped
# script argument reads as its group. The last two are a slot filled by a
# state change (falls back) and by a space (renders as TeX reads it), pinned
# as they are and out of scope.
2\sin^2 x
x\sin^2 x
-\sin^2 x
\sin^2 x\cos^2 x
(a+b)\sin^2 x
\frac{1}{2}\sin^2 x
n\log_2 n
x\log_2^2 n
2\max_i a_i
2\max\limits_i a_i
x_\max
T_\min + 1
x_\min^\max
2\hat\sin^2 x
x^\rm a
x^\, 2

# Three or more primes (#1628, CD21): spoken from the folded tree, exposed from
# the loose one, brailled from it with an authored glyph spelled as primes.
f''''(x)
f'''''(x)
\sin'''(x)
f\dprime'(x)
f\trprime(x)
2\sin^2 x + f'''(x)

# Fraction and root arguments, authored primes and script positions (#1629,
# #1628, the plan lead's second ruling): a function as an ungrouped fraction
# or root argument reads as its group; an authored triple or quadruple prime
# after a carrier brailles as its primes, while one in a superscript or after
# no carrier keeps MathCAT's stray full stop; a script takes the position its
# base sets.
\frac x\sin y
\frac\sin x y
\sqrt[3]\sin x
\sqrt[\sin]x y
\frac x\hat\sin y
f\qprime(x)
\sin\trprime(x)
f^{\trprime}(x)
(fg)\trprime
\liminf\limits_{n}^\max x
\max\limits_\min x
\displaystyle x_\max y
\int_0^\max f
